One of the staff members was extremely helpful—he understood exactly what I wanted and quietly delivered without unnecessary back and forth. They have a good collection of stationery items, especially gift-wrapping papers, gift bags, and other essentials.

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Varma
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited this stationery shop yesterday to buy Sundaram A5 size sheets. It costed Rs 55, but the owner quoted ₹75, despite questioning him again. I was in a rush, so I couldn’t verify the price and accepted it. He was busy talking to a woman and didn’t pay attention to me. When he handed me change, he gave me ₹30 instead of ₹25. I had to return the extra ₹5 because he was distracted. People say he has a habit of overcharging customers. Overall, my experience was disappointing, and I wouldn’t recommend this shop.

featured_reviews.name: DR. QAYUM MUKADDAM
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of my favourite places. The store is nicely kept and maintained. They have almost everything in stationery and beyond. People working here are very efficient, quick and helpful. Just one small suggestion-It would be better if they have a smile on their faces, except for Shailesh and the person at the Counter. Shailesh is the life and soul of the shop, moving about swiftly, knowing exactly what is kept where. He is very soft spoken and kind. I have never seen him lose his cool or 'not smiling'
He even guides and directs his colleagues in s very nice manner do that they too learn quickly and provide full customer satisfaction.

featured_reviews.name: Parth Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:

Very high prices compared to other stationeries. And nothing superior about it except that it is air conditioned which isn't actually a requirement from the customer angle for a stationery. featured_reviews.review_text:
Very reliable and student-friendly xerox shop!
The shopkeeper is extremely friendly, helpful, and always patient with students. The rates are very reasonable compared to other nearby shops, and they give good discounts when you take xerox or printouts in bulk, which is super helpful for college work.
They also have small calculators available, which is a lifesaver sometimes. One unique and very useful service is that they provide white lab coats on rent for a day, which is great for students who don’t want to buy one.

featured_reviews.name: Devang Padelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The college stationery is one of the most important parts of campus life as it provides all the essential materials required by students on a daily basis. From notebooks, records, and printouts to lab files and basic stationery items, everything is available under one roof. The prices are affordable, which makes it very convenient for students, especially those who need materials regularly.
One of the best aspects of the stationery is Pravin, whose helpful nature and polite behavior make the experience even better. He always guides students properly and ensures they get what they need without any hassle. His cooperation and friendliness truly stand out.
Overall, the college stationery is reliable, student-friendly, and budget-friendly, making it an essential support system for every college student.
